obligation.exact_statement: Establish a theorem-level statistical-prior and observation-access comparison for the frozen D1-D8 project, without asserting novelty or root closure. For stationary second-order K-symbol histories H of length N, explicitly define the full-ordered-history suffix-average add-one predictor B_N(y)=(N-1)^(-1) sum_{l=2}^N [n_{E_N,y}(H_l)+1]/[n_{E_N}(H_l)+K], where E_N is the actual terminal pair. Give a self-contained finite-N expected KL upper proof using the sequential Dirichlet-one code and pointwise multinomial bound; a candidate bound is U_KN=[2 log K+K^2(K-1)log(1+(N-1)/K^2)]/(N-1). Derive valid actual-terminal expected TV, conditional TV with pi_s, and stationary-weighted risk consequences, and exhibit strictly positive distributions demonstrating why a KL lower bound alone cannot be reversed into a TV lower bound. Verify against the exact primary Han-Jana-Wu arXiv2106.13947v2 Eq95, Lemma6, Theorem22 and Section5.2, separating already-covered statistical objects from this project's actual finite-code/resource claims and resolving any display normalization ambiguity by the self-contained derivation. Prove or refute exact nonfactorization of this statistical predictor through the admitted canonical quantized Route A observation cut: the candidate histories 000100 and001000 have the same eight transition counts and terminal00 but B_N(1)=8/15 and2/5. Check the actual finite score/exponential schedule, all aggregate copies, canonical erasure, query/terminal/public fields and downstream factorization using exact admitted Facts26a62994567c7f02,199c7b2000c58e6b and54c3088eb3c35a36 where their contents apply. Equal decoded unquantized summaries alone are not whole-code identity; if an extra field prevents the collision, retain the failed alternative and classify the exact observation instead. State any randomized-decoder functional approximation consequence separately from prediction-risk lower bounds; these two histories must have positive probability under legal stationary D1/D5 processes. Verify the exact iid per-sensor/communication/regularity assumptions of Han-Ozgur-Weissman arXiv1802.08417v4 Theorem1 and transcript Lemma1; demonstrate the structural-overlap obstruction to the naive iid substitution P(Y0=00,Y1=11)=0 versus vw>0 on D5, and count the alphabet of all eight canonical summary coordinates plus preserved endpoint/query fields, distinguishing b fractional bits from total observation bits and internal registers. Do not claim that another reduction is impossible or that failed direct substitution establishes novelty. Record a source-verified comparison of object, access, architecture, quantifiers, resources and risk. No same-budget circuit implementation is claimed for the suffix-average statistical comparator; any such extension must be independently charged. This is one bounded mathematical comparison prerequisite for C4 and accurate C2 interpretation, not a generic Transformer lower bound, optimal TV rate, novelty certification or root admission.

verification_report.summary:
Reviewed the frozen C4-statistical-010/counter-v1 submission sequentially under contract 3aa0ff5ddc4dd7295ab94404797636c9f50fa30cd6e7249cc5f98467b5f1179a, including P1/P3/P5/P6 and cited-fact chain checks. No critical errors or unresolved gaps were found. The normalized Dirichlet-one code, pointwise multinomial bound, stationarity and KL chain rule establish the stated U_KN with one division by N-1. The actual-terminal, conditional and stationary-weighted TV consequences and the strictly positive KL/TV counterexample are valid.

Read the admitted statements and relevant proof contents of Facts 26a62994567c7f02, 199c7b2000c58e6b and 54c3088eb3c35a36. Their scopes support the expanded finite exponential schedule, complete canonical erasure, endpoint/query fields and deterministic downstream factorization. The two histories have identical canonical observations and distinct suffix averages 8/15 and 2/5; their common probability in the explicit stationary D5 example is 3/896. The randomized-decoder 1/15 consequence is correctly confined to functional approximation. The eight-coordinate alphabet bounds, preserved side fields and precision/resource distinctions are valid.

The cited results and hypotheses were checked against [Han–Jana–Wu v2](https://arxiv.org/html/2106.13947v2), Eq95, Lemma6, Theorem22 and Section5.2, and [Han–Özgür–Weissman v4](https://arxiv.org/html/1802.08417v4), Theorem1, Assumptions1–3 and transcript Lemma1. The normalization ambiguity is bypassed by the independent derivation, and the overlap example correctly defeats only the naive iid substitution. The theorem-search tool was unavailable under the approval policy; direct primary-source web access resolved the reference checks. This is same-model independent-context LLM admission review, without server-internal attestation or formal certification. Existing admitted dependencies were used within scope rather than re-certified; auxiliary scripts/manifests were not mathematical premises. No same-budget implementation of B_N, prediction-risk lower bound from the collision, novelty judgment or root closure is admitted. This is an LLM review, not formal verification or external peer review; cross-model independence is not established.
